Additionally, the project advances local businesses' capabilities to identify new business opportunities and models, develop customer-oriented products, services, and joint offerings, and enhance sales particularly in international markets. Mikkeli Development Company Miksei Oy is responsible for exploring and opening new markets, improving companies' readiness for internationalization, product development, and marketing, and supporting sales efforts in so-called new markets (primarily the USA, France, Spain, and the UK). Furthermore, MikseiMikkeli is tasked with increasing the region's awareness and executing media and PR work. Lake Saimaa Region introduction Lake Saimaa region is Finland's largest lake region. Saimaa’s countryside is famous for its beautiful sparkling lakes, boundless green forests and vast archipelago. With thousands of miles of shoreline, charming lakeside resorts, manor houses, villas and saunas, interesting history and a great gastronomy and a variety of activities, Lake Saimaa’s preserved natural beauty makes it a stunning destination adored by both the locals and visitors. The objective of the tender The primary goals of the tender: - To identify and contract a PR agency capable of delivering strategic communications that amplify Lake Saimaa’s presence and appeal in both the US and UK markets during the designated period. - The agency will be expected to develop and implement comprehensive PR campaigns, employing innovative approaches and local market expertise to position Lake Saimaa as a must-visit destination for discerning travelers. - The scope of work includes designing integrated media strategies, cultivating high-value partnerships, and creating impactful storytelling that distinguishes Lake Saimaa from competitors. Requirements of the selected agency - The agency must be able to propose activities in both USA and UK within the stated budget. - In addition to the core activities listed, the agency must demonstrate a proactive approach in identifying emerging trends and opportunities within the travel and lifestyle sectors, adapting strategies to remain ahead of the curve. - Expertise in digital storytelling, social media amplification, and cross-market collaboration will be essential for driving sustained engagement and visibility. - The ability to present innovative ideas—grounded in data and tailored to Lake Saimaa’s brand personality—will be key in differentiating the destination amid a competitive international landscape. - Agencies with proven international experience, creative vision, and the operational capacity and senior level experience to deliver measurable results for Lake Saimaa 2.0 in both the US and UK will be prioritized in the selection process. Procurement procedure and budget for tender The procurement will be executed as a reverse tendering process with a fixed service price. The evaluation of tenders will be based on qualitative factors. Maximum monthly retainer budget TOTAL is 4500 EUR per month for a 4-month project for both USA and UK activities. Total budget for 4 months is 18 000 EUR. With option to extend the contract with Saimaa Horizon project budget. Questions related to the tender must be submitted via Cloudia platform by October 3rd, 2025.
